name: Ristikontra
summary: Finnish 4-player partnership trick game where a trick is won by the last card matching the rank led.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships, partners opposite. Use 52 cards. Point values: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2, else 0, total 120. Deal six cards each, remainder is face-down stock. Left of dealer leads. Trick of four cards: winner is last player to play a card of same rank as led; suit irrelevant. Winner leads next. After playing from hand, draw top of stock to keep six cards. You may instead flip top stock card and must play it, not drawing. When stock empty play last six tricks without draw. You may not lead same rank to four consecutive tricks; after three same-rank leads you must change rank. Count points in won tricks. 61+ wins 1 game point, 120 wins 2, 60-60 carries point to next deal. First team to agreed target, usually 7, wins match.
rating_reason: Sedma group trick game, equal-rank win, strategic hidden hands
